career_ladder.note: Technical telecommunications and wireless operations branch of the Uttar Pradesh Police (Radio Headquarters, Mahanagar, Lucknow). Personnel operate VHF/UHF wireless networks, digital communication repeaters, cyber telematics, and encryption systems, advancing through technical cadres and promotion quotas.

exam_scheme.note: Selection process comprises an Online Written Examination (CBT) of 400 marks (160 questions, 150 minutes) with a strict requirement of obtaining minimum 50% qualifying marks in each of the four subject sections, followed by DV/PST and Physical Efficiency Test (PET).

financial_package.note: Assistant Radio Operators (the largest group in the recruitment) are placed in Pay Level 4 (Entry Basic Pay ₹25,500) under the Uttar Pradesh Revised Pay Rules, 2016. Head Radio Operators are placed in Level 6 (₹35,400) and Workshop Staff in Level 3 (₹21,700). Technical personnel receive communication allowance, diet subsidy, and kit allowances.
financial_package.pay_source_label: UP Revised Pay Rules 2016 Level 4 (Assistant Operator Cadre) & Advt. PRPB-एक(Radio)-2022
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 4 entry basic pay of ₹25,500 (Assistant Operator post) with 58% DA (₹14,790), technical maintenance allowance, HRA (₹1,800 to ₹4,500), kit allowance, net of 10% NPS deduction (₹4,029) and GIS.
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) revised bi-annually per UP government finance orders
House Rent Allowance (HRA) categorized by district class
Diet Allowance / Ration Subsidy for police telecommunication personnel
Annual Uniform and Kit Maintenance Allowance
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% matching contribution
Medical reimbursement under UP Government Servants Medical Attendance Rules
